tickets.title: Reconcile verified source and rules evidence without changing prerequisites
gate_cmd:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('docs/roadmap/system.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([r['decisions'],r['work_items']],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()=='ddf567b26b7a68cc051266e81ea535247823d1aeae1e209ac0756a225fd6bbbe'
a={x['id']:x for x in r['data_assets']}
assert a['rules-license-pack']['availability']=='tracked'
assert a['legacy-source-bundles']['availability']=='catalog_only'
assert 'docs/design/headless-2026-11-13/source-evidence.json' in a['legacy-source-bundles']['evidence_paths']
assert 'docs/design/headless-2026-11-13/evidence/knave-1e/manifest.json' in a['rules-license-pack']['evidence_paths']
for x in r['data_assets']:
 for path in x['evidence_paths']:assert Path(path).is_file(),path
m=json.loads(Path('docs/design/headless-2026-11-13/evidence/knave-1e/manifest.json').read_text())
assert m['kernel_selected'] is False and m['w17_contract_review_complete'] is False
for x in m['artifacts']:
 b=Path('docs/design/headless-2026-11-13/evidence/knave-1e',x['path']).read_bytes()
 assert len(b)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
print('PASS refreshed evidence availability, exact license bytes and unchanged dependency decisions')
